accessibility.title: Observe Worker Recovery flow
accessibility.description: An encrypted archive is authenticated, restored in an isolated disposable namespace, and used to start workers, verify readiness, replay a test carrier, and confirm duplicate recognition while preserving records and inbox counts. Nonempty queues block verification.

review_notes: Verify whether "six deployed NutsNews workers" and the listed worker roles still match current production terminology.
Confirm the backup age limit of "no older than eight days" and the evidence expiration rule remain current.
Check that backend PR 545 is still the correct change reference and that its preflight/apply status has not changed.
Verify the acceptance threshold of "at least 76 percent across two fresh fleet checks fifteen minutes apart".
Confirm the isolation details: 2 CPUs, 8 GiB RAM, no swap, loopback-only networking, and no production sockets.
Review whether the Qwen dependency isolation note for approval is still accurate and should remain public in simple documentation.
Verify that public health is intended to expose only sanitized outcomes, scope, and timestamps.
Confirm that the shared backup protection behavior and excluded directories are still correct.
